slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: SD-WAN (software-defined WAN) intelligently manages and routes traffic across multiple internet connections and sites, improving resilience and performance and prioritising business-critical applications.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: What happens if our main internet line fails?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: With automatic failover, for example to a second line or 4G/5G, your connectivity switches over automatically, keeping you online while the primary line is restored.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Yes. We design and manage secure, reliable connectivity between your sites so they work as one network, with central management and monitoring.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: Do you provide the internet lines too?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Yes. We source leased lines and business broadband on your behalf, then configure and manage the whole connectivity setup as a single service.
